{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Horror''' was a [[Flying]] enemy that appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. On top of being a [[Flying]] enemy, it would sometimes spawn as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning towers with both detections were needed to take it down. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Horror''' is a giant, flying beast with an exposed skull. It has a tail and what appeared to be horns. Its skull is black and has purple lights in its eyeholes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *As it has quite high health, decent speed and due to it being a [[Flying]] enemy, decent towers with flying detection like the [[Golden Soldier]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]] or [[Gatling Gun]] are recommended against this. **Due to it appearing as also a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy on later waves, it is best to bring in towers that have both flying and hidden detection. *Due to it being a [[Flying]] enemy with the [[Stun Immunity]], most forms of stalling are either completely useless or less effective on it, even if the stalling tower can target it. **All forms of freezing cannot stall it, making [[Snowballer]] and [[Frost Blaster]] unable to slow it down. **Stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Archer]] will only slow it down instead of fully stopping it. *Towers like the [[Firework Technician]] can be used to grant towers hidden and flying detections, which is especially useful as it starts spawning as a [[Flying]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy. **The [[Ace Pilot]] can also be helpful for towers which have flying detection but not hidden detection, like the [[Ranger]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail6.png|'''Corrupted Horror''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Animation}} CorruptedHorrorFloat.gif|Floating animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedHorror.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedHorrorIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Horror''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Horror''' is a corrupted version of the [[Cursed Horror]], though with its ability to stun towers and damage units on death removed. *The '''Corrupted Horror''' is unaffected by enemy
